title: On the diffraction spectrum of the set of visible points in lattices and certain cut-and-project sets
summary: Let $k\geq 2$ be a positive integer. It is known that the set of visible lattice points from the origin in $\mathbb{Z}^k$ has a translation bounded pure point diffraction spectrum. We investigate these properties for sets of points simultaneously visible from a finite set of lattice points $ \{\mathbf{x}_1,\dots,\mathbf{x}_n\} \subseteq \mathbb{Z}^k$. We provide explicit formulas for the coefficients of the diffraction spectrum.
